{{Top|leg}}
'''Quadrillium''' was a mineral found in abundance in [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]], particularly within the [[Tava Yagen]] asteroid field. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], it was valued at approximately 50-75 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|Credits]] per kilogram.

Quadrillium was mined on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Essowyn]].<ref name="PoG1">''[[Planets of the Galaxy, Volume One]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Quadrillium is misspelled as "quadrillum" in a table of metals and minerals appearing on page 37 of ''[[Pirates & Privateers]]''. It is spelled correctly in other instances throughout.
